Definition: to be pungent; i.e. in taste (sour, i.e. literally fermented, or figuratively, harsh), in color (dazzling)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be leavened, be sour; 1a) (Qal) to be leavened; 1b) (Hiphil) to taste something leavened; 1c) (Hithpael) to be embittered, grieved; 2) to be cruel, oppress, be ruthless; 3) to be red
